Description: Sets up and manages HR-specific user profiles, employee records, roles, groups, and skill assignments.
Manages the creation and transition of sensitive employee profiles, including onboarding and offboarding.
Defines the services, fulfillment templates, topic categories, and criteria that govern case creation and routing.
Handles the initiation of employee requests from all channels (portal, chat, phone, email) and assigns an HR case number.
Manages the progression of an HR case through its lifecycle, including status changes, worknotes, and task fulfillment.
Linking relevant self-service knowledge articles to an active HR case to aid the agent or solve the issue.
Manages the automated and manual assignment of HR cases and tasks to specialized agents based on skills, criteria, and capacity.
Defines rules for automatically escalating cases based on time/priority and manages employee communication updates.
Monitors service level agreements linked to HR cases, detecting breaches and managing corresponding actions.
Provides real-time metrics and aggregated counts on case volumes, assignments, and resolution performance.
Creates, distributes, and collects employee feedback related to specific cases or HR services delivered.
Provides processes and access controls for handling high-sensitivity cases like misconduct or grievance investigations.
